defaults.personalMessage: You fill every room with light and laughter. We love you to the moon and back!

lockStage.heading: A Magical World Awaits, {name}
lockStage.subtitle: Press and hold the enchanted lock until the light breaks free.

prepStage.title: Prepare the Party Room
prepStage.subtitle: Hang the garlands, then blow up the balloons.

garlandTrace.instruction: Drag the golden spark to the next post to hang the garland.

balloonRow.instruction: Press and hold each balloon to blow it up.

celebrationStage.blowInstruction: Press and hold to blow out the candles

finaleStage.promptInstructionSpeech: Press the star and say your wish out loud.
finaleStage.promptInstructionType: Press the star, then write down your wish.
finaleStage.doneText: The PDF has been saved to your downloads. Happy birthday, {name}!

certificate.heading: Happy Birthday,
certificate.story: Once upon a starlit night, in a kingdom woven from moonbeams and laughter, the fairies gathered from every corner of the enchanted forest to celebrate the most important soul in the realm. For today, {name} turns {age} years old — and the whole kingdom sparkles a little brighter because of it. The garlands are hung, the candles are lit, and the magic is only just beginning.
certificate.footer: Certified Magical by the Fairy Council · {date}
